items.title: Skift Global Forum: Five Decisions in the Room
items.summary: Every leader at Skift Global Forum is recalibrating amid technological and economic disruption. The open question is whether they’re doing it for the right decade.

items.title: Navan Buys BoomPop to Push Into Meetings and Events
items.summary: A public travel company growing 35% is buying its way into the meetings-and-events spend that managed travel never tamed.

items.title: Choice’s New CEO Has 3 Top Fixes — Plus $450 Million in Hotels to Sell
items.summary: New CEO Dominic Dragisich says Choice's build-and-buy era is over. His formula is to grow U.S. room count, close the revenue-generation gap with peer brands like Wyndham, and sell real estate it doesn't need to own.

items.title: EU Unveils Rules to Help Cities Crack Down on Airbnbs
items.summary: Brussels has laid out a legal roadmap for restricting short-term rentals in stressed housing markets. Critics argue the rules lack oversight.

items.title: Marriott CEO Says AI Will Impact Hotel Distribution First
items.summary: Marriott CEO Anthony Capuano was asked where AI is showing up in practice. He said the "biggest impact" so far has been on "distribution," or how travelers discover hotels online.

items.title: United Airlines’ CEO Wants The U.S. To Fund SAF Like It Funded Solar
items.summary: Supply chain woes have long blocked the uptake of SAF, but United Airlines’ Scott Kirby sees potential in corn and soy currently grown for biodiesel. He wants more government support to firm up the industry — but criticized Europe’s approach.

items.title: Why the Personal AI Assistant Hype Matters More for Travel Than Any AI Travel Product
items.summary: The biggest shift in AI travel may be happening outside travel, as general-purpose agents learn to book, rebook, and act for the customer.

items.title: European Vacation Rental Platform Awaze Felt Affordability Squeeze in 2025
items.summary: Europe's largest holiday-rental group grew adjusted earnings and narrowed its loss in 2025, but revenue slipped, its cash position shrunk, and the group slid into net liabilities ahead of a 2028 refinancing.
